note: The margin over the blank control is the headline, not the accuracy. A model that answers NOT SPEAKING to everything scores 50% on a two-class task and 100% on the silent class, which is why the blank control is run at the same count as the real conditions.

frames from one session are correlated, so the effective sample size is far below the frame count
